column1: # Magical Girl Witch Trials (Switch, update 2.0.1b = v65536): Unity 6000.0.72f1 IL2CPP with FMOD on NVN, SDK 21.4.7; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# 644 Addressables bundles under Data/StreamingAssets/aa/Switch hold 2.62 GB of the 2.65 GB RomFS; the shaders are Unity 6 Shader objects in those bundles (their type trees name the
# engine version), which shader_split.py reads through unityfs.py as for Hollow Knight: Silksong's 6000.0 build. Started from the NSP script's provisional profile
# (dm/games/profile_guess.py); the constants are the survey's (01006C5027060000_survey/survey.md). Format: see dm/games/README.md
# the update NSP is v65536; the extracted version dir is v65536 (display version 2.0.1b from the control data)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: Unity 6's nninitStartup sets no StandardAllocator and reserves address regions itself
# (AllocateAddressRegion + AllocateMemoryPages), so the game gets a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region where it maps its own memory
# a visual novel played with a controller
# every bundle's Shader object holds the GLSL control section and code areas; shader_split.py reads them from the bundles and writes the profile's tables
